title: Dial in your Moza AB6 for the L-39 Albatros | MSFS Jet Class FFB Guide
description:
Dial in your Moza AB6 direct drive base for the Aero L-39 Albatros in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

The Jet Class on the 11.3-mile Roswell course is the fastest, most unforgiving track in the National Championship Air Races. Racing military jets low to the terrain introduces a punishing penalty: 4 to 6 seconds of turbofan spool lag. Induce an accelerated stall around a high-G pylon turn, and you instantly bleed all forward kinetic energy with zero immediate engine recovery. In this guide, we map complete in-game flight controls and fine-tune Moza Cockpit force feedback telemetry—calibrating dynamic aerodynamic pressure across a 220 m/s range, locking the Z-axis, and programming an authentic 12° stick shaker alongside tactical stall buffet cues so you can push the L-39 to the edge of the envelope without washing out.

Want to skip manual slider adjustments? Download the ready-to-import profiles on the website:
🔗 Download FFB & Control Profiles: https://highintheflightsimsky.nl

🛠️ CORE HARDWARE & SETTINGS COVERED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
- Moza AB6 Direct Drive Base calibration & Z-axis twist lock
- Flight Controls: Pitch/roll axes, stick-mounted wheel brakes, and trim hat configuration
- Systems Mapping: Engine throttle, spoiler/speedbrake lever, turbine ignition, landing gear toggle, flaps, and pitot heat
- Moza Cockpit Basic FFB: 85% overall intensity, 55% damper, 35% inertia, and 10% friction
- Dynamic Aerodynamics: Dynamic pressure scaling up to 220 m/s and elevator load modeling
- Stall & Transonic Buffeting: 12° AoA stick shaker (30 Hz), 80% stall buffet, and Mach 0.68–0.85 shock-induced wave buffet
- Engine & Airframe Effects: Gear/spoiler vibration mapping and afterburner cancellation for non-afterburning jets
- MSFS & Moza Cockpit profile import walkthrough
